a: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ يَا أُمَّ الرَّبِيعِ الْقِصَاصُ كِتَابُ اللَّهِ
m: Anas said: by Allah, her tooth will not be broken. He said: retaliation is the decree of Allah. But the family accepted compensation and pardoned. He said: among the servants of Allah are those who, if they swore by Allah, He would fulfil it for them.
